digest.component_or_area: gate_dispatch.py module refactoring / code_review finalization extraction
propositions: gate_dispatch.py exceeds 800 LOC soft cap and requires splitting by extracting the code-review post-verdict finalization cluster into a new leaf module finalize.py
Seven named functions and constants must be relocated from gate_dispatch.py to the new finalize.py leaf module with no back-imports from finalize to gate_dispatch
finalize.py must re-declare STEP_VERIFY, STEP_DECIDE, and _LLM_STEP_KINDS as local constants to avoid circular imports, with _attach_code_review_metrics updated to reference the local constant names
gate_dispatch.py must re-export _attach_code_review_metrics at module level for backward compatibility with existing test suites that import it from gate_dispatch
Module-size governance artifacts (allowlist, ceilings, and docs/architecture.md offenders table) must be updated to remove gate_dispatch and reflect the new finalize.py module
